data.body: RCA/update: I confirmed the false-Verified path is the Gerrit patchset checkout step in the Verified lane: the job has to fetch refs/changes/* from Gerrit before any patchset code runs, and a transient 5xx/transport failure there currently terminates the job before code is evaluated. I honored the recorded/operator ruling against Verified-0 and CI-level concurrency groups by implementing in-job step-level retry around every Gerrit patchset checkout operation used by the Verified route. The retry is local to the transport operation (15s then 45s backoff); a transient autodeploy/Gerrit contention window can recover inside the same job so the final vote reflects actual code status rather than the first transport blip. RED test added first: tests/unit/test_gerrit_checkout_retry.py failed on main because checkout steps had no retry attempts; it now passes and covers exact inputs plus three attempts across gerrit-verify and all reusable Verified-lane workflows. Targeted workflow tests pass; lint/typecheck/ratchets pass. Full make verify hit the known GIT_CONFIG artifact in tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py; the required solo confirmation with all GIT_CONFIG_* variables unset passes (13 passed). I will rerun make verify with those vars unset before push.
